title: Learned Engram portability v1
question: Can a byte-addressed N-gram table learned jointly with a source DenseLM transfer held-out fact associations to independent DenseLM recipients of two widths using only recipient-local projection and gate calibration?
mechanisms: joint source DenseLM and raw-byte table SGD
frozen-backbone recipient projection and gate calibration
independent DenseLM recipients at widths 64 and 128
hypothesis: Correctly associated source-learned rows improve recipient-held-out accuracy over each matched control at both widths across all three seeds; source or transfer failure is a valid result.
failure_interpretation: A source-gate failure means memory-sensitive source acquisition was not established and blocks export and graft interpretation. A valid negative recipient contrast means this bounded protocol did not demonstrate adapter portability; neither result is evidence against other tasks or architectures.
controls: Compare baseline, constant, globally scaled random, within-partition permuted, real zero-shot, real-adapter, and native conditions.
Use one independently prepared recipient checkpoint for all matched conditions at each width and seed.
Train the adapter only on calibration ownership; score source-monitor and recipient-held-out ownership separately.
Require all three source gates before exporting any learned table or training recipients.
Transfer table bytes only; do not transfer source backbone, optimizer, hidden state, or source adapter.
independent_variables: source seed and recipient pair seed
learned-table condition and trainable parameter ownership
fixed training/update budget and checkpoint boundary
confounders: Recipient-held-out facts are held out from recipient supervision, not from source learning.
The source-monitor split uses unseen wording but source-seen facts.
Synthetic one-character answers and generated keys do not establish ordinary-language quality.
Widths 64 and 128 retain the DenseLM architecture family; representation portability is not tested.
Native acquisition sees all source facts and is descriptive, not a matched adaptation control.
The constant control has the same adapter parameter count but lower effective feature rank.
hardware_notes: Behavioral scale and backend are selected only from measured complete timing and resource projections. Smoke is wiring-only. The sealed behavioral execution ceiling is 43,200 seconds, including timing calibration.
runtime_class: Runner-specific source-learning and portability campaign; invoke research portability build/run rather than the generic scaffold.
can_establish: Whether the executed source tables passed the prespecified memory-sensitive acquisition gate.
Controlled held-out recipient behavior at the declared synthetic task, widths, seeds, and endpoints.
Whether byte-identical table artifacts load across both declared DenseLM widths.
cannot_establish: General language competence or broad factual knowledge transfer.
Transfer to facts not acquired by the source, because the recipient-held-out facts are source-seen.
Natural-language semantic query production or teacher-derived representations.
prerequisites: Build and seal the learned portability campaign before execution; the build step materializes/audits data and writes design inputs but does not train.
A failed source gate blocks every learned export and recipient graft; no threshold relaxation or favorable seed selection is permitted.
This entry is runner-only and intentionally has no generic factorial recipe.
